article.info_title: Bing Webmaster Tools or Google Search Console: A Comparison
article.info_description: When it comes to optimizing site performance and improving search rankings, choosing the right tools can be challenging. Check out insider Fabrice Canel's in-depth comparison to find out how Bing Webmaster Tools compares with Google Search Console and what sets them apart.

article.info_title: What to know about our August 2024 core update
article.info_description:
This post announces the August 2024 core update to Google Search.
      This update is designed to continue our work to improve the quality of our search results by
      showing more content that people find genuinely useful and less content that feels like it
      was made just to perform well on Search.

article.info_title: A/B Test for Better Search Engine Performance
article.info_description: A/B testing is a powerful tool that can enhance your SEO strategy, boost search engine rankings, and drive conversions. Learn how IndexNow and Microsoft Clarity can help you gather actionable data, reduce the time it takes to see results, and optimize your website's performance.

article.info_title: Optimize your SEM Strategy and Ranking Potential with IndexNow
article.info_description: Don't let slow indexing hold your content captive. Take control with IndexNow! In this article, discover how IndexNow can boost your search engine marketing strategy, enhance your content visibility, and improve your chances of ranking as soon as your content hits the web.

article.info_title: Introducing recommendations in Google Search Console
article.info_description:
This post announces Search Console recommendations, a new feature that provides websites with optimization
      opportunities and suggests actions they can take to improve their presence on Google Search.

article.info_title: Policy update: British Columbia political content
article.info_description:
In August 2024, Google will update the Regional Restrictions under the Shopping Ads Political content policy to include regional restrictions in Canada.
In British Columbia, the following is not allowed on Google platforms:
Election advertising as defined under the Election Act, RSBC 1996, c 106.

article.info_title: Fewer ad breaks and more user engagement on YouTube connected TVs
article.info_description: Viewers are sensitive to too many ad breaks. We’ve found that 79% of viewers would prefer video ads grouped together instead of distributed throughout a video.1 The less frequently viewers are interrupted, the more likely they are to continue watching their favorite content. That’s why we launched fewer, longer ad breaks when viewers watch longer videos on connected TVs. Since launch, we’ve expanded this experience to more types of longform viewing experiences.
